newsitem.title: UK: Hewlett-Packard slides in London on results.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard slides in London on results.

text.p: Shares in Hewlett-Packard Co plunged $5 or over eight percent in London on Friday after the computer manufacturer reported sluggish order and revenue growth in the second quarter.
After Wall Street's close on Thursday, the company reported Q2 earnings of $0.75 a share compared with a First Call estimate of $0.80 a share.
"Other high-techs have been reporting pretty good results recently so this came as a bit of a shock to the market," one market maker here said.

Although net earnings fell short of the consensus forecast, sector analysts were more worried about lacklustre growth in such products as printers, which some said could be evidence that the product line could be maturing.

"I'm puzzled. I've never seen anything like this," said one U.S. analyst during a conference call with Hewlett executives, referring to evidence that printer growth was well below that of personal computers for the industry.
Hewlett shares, which closed $2-1/4 higher to $58-7/8 on Thursday in anticipation of positive results, had risen $9-3/4 or around 20 percent since hitting a 1997 closing low of $49-1/8 on April 21.
